items.title: Ida Goodson Interview, 1961-05-06
items.q: Then I worked with Carl Davis a while.

ctx.x: I heard y'all talk about it.

Well, I started playing out with him. And then from then on, different bands. I worked with Wally Murray City. In fact, we was on air for years around here. We worked at Cypher and the Cypher and the Cypher and the Club and all these spots around here. We worked all night for a break. I worked with Wally Murray City for about, oh, I said around about almost near 16 years. He and I, you know, Wally back was in force like that. Then I worked with Carl Davis a while. How do you spell that? Which one, Wally's? Davis.…
That's funny, I was having a drink and, uh, at the country club. Yes, I am. And the bartender there was saying that, uh,
